sn35.52:2.1: “Bhikkhus, all is impermanent…. All is suffering…. All is nonself….
sn35.52:2.2: All is to be directly known…. All is to be fully understood….
sn35.52:2.3: All is to be abandoned…. All is to be realized….
sn35.52:2.4: All is to be fully understood through direct knowledge….
sn35.52:3.2: Each to be completed as in §33.
